title: Fix local demo data visibility across scorecards/items/evaluations
description: Ensure seeded local records are returned by dashboard local-mode queries so lab scorecards, items, and evaluations pages render non-empty demo data.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented compatibility fix for legacy index-root names still used by dashboard queries. Added alias classification in services/private-graphql-proxy/proxy/schema_contract.py so roots like listItemByAccountIdAndCreatedAt and listEvaluationByAccountIdAndUpdatedAt route to local index handlers. Added regression coverage in test_operation_classifier.py and test_app_routing.py. Verified dockerized tests pass and live GraphQL checks now return seeded records for legacy roots (items/evaluations) and scorecards list returns seeded data.
